vt1025012.title: Nikon COOLPIX P1100 16MP 125x Zoom Digital Camera Black with Dot Sight and Box
vt1025012.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
vt1025012.details: Nikon COOLPIX P1100 superzoom bridge camera in black, with a 16 megapixel sensor, a 125x optical zoom lens (24-3000 mm equivalent), 4K video, an electronic viewfinder and a vari-angle LCD. Condition: used only 3 times and kept with its original box and papers; clean overall with no noticeable scratches or dirt, as shown in the photos. Included, as shown in the photos: the camera with its lens cap and hood, the strap, the original box, the Japanese manual, one Nikon battery, two third-party EN-EL20 batteries, a third-party USB battery charger with its cable, and a Nikon DF-M1 dot sight. The manual is in Japanese. No SD card is included.
vt1025012.why: A used Nikon COOLPIX P1100 superzoom digital camera with dot sight and box.
vt1025012.perfect: Wildlife, sports and moon photographers who want an extreme-zoom camera in one body.
